'''''Vicia peregrina''''', the '''wandering vetch''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Fabaceae]]. They are climbers and have compound, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 0.32 m.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vicia peregrina L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/703223|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Vicia peregrina (Slender-leaved Vetch): MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/FABC/Vicia_peregrina.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
